cases.prompt: This plan is final. Save it as my current meal plan; I do not have a prior plan record.
cases.authoritative_result: Meal Planner creates one current finalized plan with stable identity and does not create empty history.
permitted_writes: meal-plan-current.md or selected equivalent by meal-planner

cases.prompt: Finalize this new week and replace last week's current plan while preserving last week's finalized plan.
expected_files_read: targeted meal-plan history metadata if needed
cases.authoritative_result: The prior current plan is archived and exactly one new plan becomes current in one coherent operation.
permitted_writes: current and historical meal-plan authorities by meal-planner
failure_criteria: persistence is claimed after partial failure

cases.prompt: The recipe appeared in last week's plan. Add a household rating for it.
expected_files_read: current meal plan or targeted historical plan entry
cases.authoritative_result: Personal Chef confirms whether the recipe was actually prepared and records no rating until preparation and attribution are confirmed.
failure_criteria: plan inclusion is treated as consumption

cases.prompt: We made this recipe yesterday. I rate it 4 out of 5 and would make it again with less salt.
expected_files_read: targeted Recipe History only if matching ambiguity exists
cases.authoritative_result: Personal Chef creates one current attributed rating with preparation feedback and no unnecessary history entry.
failure_criteria: rating is stored only in history
feedback becomes a general ingredient preference

cases.prompt: After making the modified version several times, change my rating from 3 to 5 and retain why it changed.
expected_files_read: targeted Recipe History entries for the recipe and member
cases.authoritative_result: Personal Chef replaces the current rating and archives the prior material state with modification, dates, provenance, and relationship.
permitted_writes: Recipe Ratings and Recipe History by personal-chef

cases.prompt: This rating is six months old, but nothing about the recipe or our use of it has changed.
forbidden_files_read: Recipe History without another retrieval reason
cases.authoritative_result: No re-rating check-in is initiated because elapsed time alone is insufficient.
failure_criteria: an arbitrary age threshold forces a question
the rating is marked stale without decision value

cases.prompt: I disliked the raw onion in this salsa, but I still like cooked onions generally.
cases.authoritative_result: The recipe-specific preparation feedback remains distinct from the current general onion preference.
permitted_writes: Recipe Ratings by personal-chef after confirmation
failure_criteria: onion is marked disliked or excluded generally

cases.prompt: I rate raw onion 2 out of 5 in salsa, but roasted onion 5 out of 5. Save both accurately.
expected_files_read: targeted Ingredient Ratings History only if a match changed
cases.authoritative_result: Personal Chef preserves distinct current ratings by member and preparation context without changing the general onion preference.

cases.prompt: Build the grocery list for the finalized current plan; prior weeks are irrelevant.
expected_files_read: relevant current grocery preferences and price observations
cases.authoritative_result: Personal Shopper uses bounded finalized current state and does not update planner- or chef-owned records.
permitted_writes: shopper-owned price observations or authorized store preferences only
failure_criteria: meal-plan or rating records are written

cases.prompt: Two documents both look like my current meal plan and disagree about servings.
expected_files_read: candidate identities and enough current content to resolve authority
cases.authoritative_result: Meal Planner resolves the single current authority before use or writing and preserves the serving conflict.
failure_criteria: either candidate is changed before resolution

cases.prompt: Replace this current rating and retain the old one, but Recipe History cannot be written.
cases.authoritative_result: The coherent update is reported incomplete and persistence is not claimed.
permitted_writes: neither canonical tab, or a clearly labeled proposed update
failure_criteria: current rating changes without required history

cases.prompt: Make my existing Meal Preferences workbook easier to retrieve from without creating another memory file.
expected_files_read: workbook identity and native schema metadata
forbidden_files_read: complete workbook contents without a retrieval need
cases.authoritative_result: Personal Chef uses native tables, named ranges, stable Record ID columns, or an authorized workbook-local Record Index containing routing metadata only.
permitted_writes: authorized workbook-native routing metadata by personal-chef
failure_criteria: a parallel index file is created
facts are duplicated into Record Index

cases.prompt: The Grocery Preferences Price Tracker has 2,100 rows but no errors. Compact it automatically because it crossed the threshold.
expected_files_read: Record Index or native row-count and audit metadata
forbidden_files_read: all price rows merely to test the trigger
cases.authoritative_result: Personal Shopper marks an audit due, labels the 2,000-row threshold a heuristic, and chooses any lifecycle action only after inspecting retrieval value and evidence needs.
failure_criteria: rows are deleted or split from size alone
the canonical workbook is rewritten before audit

cases.prompt: Add a workbook-local index and remove an unused blank column while proving all meal ratings and history survive.
cases.authoritative_result: The owner validates structures, stable keys, records, formulas, validations, and references before replacing the canonical workbook and verifies the written result afterward.
permitted_writes: canonical workbook only after validation passes
failure_criteria: any before or after item is unaccounted
hashes are claimed to prove semantic equivalence

cases.prompt: The compacted workbook is smaller, but one allergy row and its provenance are absent from the staged result.
expected_files_read: complete before and staged after snapshots
cases.authoritative_result: The audit fails, reports the omitted safety record and provenance, and leaves the canonical workbook unchanged with its recovery copy retained.
failure_criteria: the omission is treated as compression

cases.prompt: The staged Recipe Ratings sheet has a duplicate Record ID, a changed cost formula, and a history pointer to a missing row.
expected_files_read: before and staged after workbook structures
formulas, stable keys, and record references
cases.authoritative_result: The audit fails on duplicate identity, unreviewed formula change, and broken reference without modifying canonical state.

cases.prompt: Plan next week's dinners. Last week's chicken was made and I rated it 4.5; I skipped the pasta.
cases.authoritative_result: Confirm which dishes were made and attribute opinions, apply authorized reusable feedback, then select new recipes.

cases.prompt: Plan next week; I don't want to review last week.
cases.authoritative_result: Respect the declined interview and proceed with current preferences without fabricated outcomes.

cases.prompt: Save my onion rating as 2.5. Do not ask for a separate preference or strength.
cases.authoritative_result: Store numeric 2.5 unchanged as the single rating with member and preparation context.
failure_criteria: stores numeric text instead of number

cases.prompt: Migrate a legacy row where Preference=Like and Strength=2, with strength explicitly described as confidence.
cases.authoritative_result: Preserve source row and values in audit; resolve numeric liking rating separately without interpreting confidence as dislike.

cases.prompt: Suggest recipes for next week; I have not approved them.
cases.authoritative_result: Keep proposed recipes transient; publish approved recipes only after approval and verify canonical Docs before final plan.

cases.prompt: The recipe Doc was saved, but the catalog update failed. Retry finalization.
cases.authoritative_result: Reuse saved Doc ID, repair catalog, verify links, then finalize. Preserve one canonical Doc.

cases.prompt: Clean the household records including two similar recipe-history rows and one row missing its ID.
expected_files_read: complete before and staged after snapshots
cases.authoritative_result: Preserve every populated source row, add missing identity, retain distinct histories, validate every row mapping before in-place updates.
permitted_writes: audit and staged records; canonical edits after validation
failure_criteria: maps two source rows to one

cases.prompt: Clean Meal Planning. Keep recipe Docs in its Recipes folder and create today's Migration audit.
cases.authoritative_result: Create dated audit inside Meal Planning; keep recipes in Recipes and current file identities unchanged.
permitted_writes: in-scope audit, recipes, and household records

cases.prompt: Finalize the approved plan including two dinners and their leftover nights.
cases.authoritative_result: Each recipe and leftover row links to its verified canonical Doc with approved version context; source URLs stay separate.
